comment: Fixture itinerary aggregate in the exact shape itinerary-service GET /api/itineraries/:id returns (flat camelCase, see its itineraryRepository.getItineraryAggregate). Used by scripts/render-fixture-pdf.ts to prove PDF generation offline.
importantNotes: Bring your passport — hotels may ask for it at check-in
Buy a Suica card for trains on day 1
Carry cash: many small ramen shops are cash-only
